themeEditor.confirmLeaveMessage: Some changes aren't saved yet. If you go now, they stay only on this device until you come back.
themeEditor.savedDraft: Saved as draft, not live yet
themeEditor.saveInvalidSection: Couldn't save: there's a problem in {section} ({page}).
themeEditor.saveInvalidPage: Couldn't save: there's a problem in {page}.
themeEditor.saveInvalid: Couldn't save: part of the theme has a problem.
themeEditor.saveBlocked: Some changes haven't been saved yet, so nothing went on your store. Try again in a moment.
themeEditor.saveBlockedInvalid: One part of this theme still has a problem, so nothing went on your store. The message above says which part.
themeEditor.confirmDiscardMessage: Everything you changed since the last time this theme went on your store goes for good. Your store keeps the look it has now.
themeEditor.draftDiscarded: Draft discarded. Your store hasn't changed.
themeEditor.leaveHint: Your changes are saved as a draft. Your store still shows what it showed before.
themeEditor.leaveSaveHint: Shoppers see the changes right away.
themeEditor.leaveKeepHint: The draft waits here for you. Your store doesn't change.
themeEditor.leaveDiscardHint: The draft is deleted and your store keeps the look it has now.
themeEditor.conflictTitle: This theme was changed somewhere else
themeEditor.conflictMessage: Someone else, or another tab of yours, saved this theme while you were working on it. Take their version and carry on from it, or keep yours.
themeEditor.conflictLoadWarning: Loading the latest drops the changes you just made here.
themeEditor.conflictKeepWarning: Keeping yours replaces their draft, and the changes they made are lost. Your store doesn't change either way.
themeEditor.unsentRestored: Changes you hadn't saved on this device are back.
themeEditor.unsentAsk: This device has changes that weren't saved. The theme was changed somewhere else since, so restoring them replaces those changes.
themeEditor.previewUnavailable: The preview isn't responding. Check your connection, then reload it.
themeEditor.previewLimited: The preview was opened too many times in the last hour. Try again a little later.
themeEditor.previewOtherStore: The preview is open for another store in this browser.
themeEditor.previewNotAllowed: You can't edit this store's theme any more, so the preview has closed.
themeEditor.previewNotEntitled: Themes aren't available for this store right now, so the preview has closed.
themeEditor.previewNoCategory: Add a category to see this page in the preview.
themeEditor.previewNoProduct: Add a product to see this page in the preview.
themeEditor.previewNoPost: Publish a blog post to see this page in the preview.
themeEditor.noSettings: There is nothing to change here. You can move it, hide it, or leave it as it is.
themeEditor.contentStore: The name, address, email and social links here come from your store details.
themeEditor.blocksFull: This can have up to {max, number} parts. Remove one to add another.
themeEditor.addBlockHint: It's added at the bottom. You can move it after.
themeEditor.confirmRemoveBlockMessage: It comes off this one, along with its settings. Your live store doesn't change until you save.
themeEditor.fieldTooLong: This is too long. Keep it to {max, number} characters.
themeEditor.fieldBadCharacters: Some characters here can't be used. Copying from a document can bring them in.
themeEditor.fieldLinkBackslash: A link can't have a backslash in it.
themeEditor.fieldLinkScheme: A link can start with http://, https://, mailto: or tel: only.
themeEditor.fieldLinkStart: A link must start with / or with http://, https://, mailto: or tel:.
themeEditor.fieldNumberRange: Write a number from {min, number} to {max, number}.
themeEditor.fieldPickDate: Pick a date and a time.
themeEditor.fieldDateHint: Bangladesh time (GMT+6). Leave it empty for no limit.
themeEditor.productHint: One of yours. Search by name.
themeEditor.productFailed: Couldn't load your products. Check your connection and try again.
themeEditor.linkHint: Pick a page of your store, or type a web address.
themeEditor.linkPoliciesFailed: Couldn't load your policies. Check your connection and try again.
themeEditor.linkPoliciesEmpty: You have no policies yet. Write them in Settings → Policies.
themeEditor.linkPolicyNotWritten: Not written yet — not shown on your shop until it is
themeEditor.linkCategoriesFailed: Couldn't load your categories. Check your connection and try again.
themeEditor.linkRenameNote: This link stops working if you rename this category or one above it, move it, or switch it off. Choose it again then.
themeEditor.linkWebHint: A full address like https://example.com, or mailto: for email and tel: for a phone number.
themeEditor.linkWebLanguage: Leave the language out: write /cart, not /en/cart. Your store puts each shopper's own language in.
themeEditor.logoPickerHint: SVG is sharpest. A PNG should have a see-through background and be at least 400 pixels wide. Up to 2 MB.

logoRefused.tooBig: That file is over 2 MB. A logo is usually far smaller — try an SVG, or a smaller PNG.
logoRefused.notALogoFile: That isn't an SVG, PNG, WebP or JPEG picture. Choose one of those.
logoRefused.svgUnreadable: That SVG couldn't be read. Export it again from your design app and try once more.
logoRefused.svgNotSafe: That SVG holds instructions a logo never needs, so it can't be used. Export it again as a plain SVG.
logoRefused.svgNoSize: That SVG doesn't say how big it is. Export it again with a viewBox, or with a width and height.
logoRefused.tooManyPixels: That picture is far larger than a logo needs. Save a smaller copy and try again.

themeEditor.pictureHint: Upload a new one, or use one you already have.
themeEditor.pictureUploadFailed: The picture didn't upload. Check your internet and try again.
themeEditor.pictureBadFile: Use a JPG, PNG, WEBP or GIF picture under 10MB.
themeEditor.pictureUsedHint: Anything you've placed in a theme before. Using one again costs nothing.
themeEditor.pictureNoneYet: You haven't used any pictures yet. Upload one to start.

slots.arrivalsRowNote: Your newest products, kept up to date
slots.bestsellersRowNote: Your most ordered, kept up to date
slots.bottomPoliciesNote: Your written policies on the right
slots.brandsRowNote: Up to six of your brands, the ones with the most on sale. Logos come from the Brands tab
slots.breadcrumbNote: Category · sub-category · product, above the pictures
slots.buyWhy: The name, price, options and buttons are fixed — this is where a shopper decides. It takes your colours, fonts and corners, and nothing else moves.
slots.cardClassicNote: Name and price, with a round add button on the picture.
slots.cardShelfNote: Name and price, with an Order now button across every card.
slots.cardStyleNote: How hard a card sells: a quiet name, or the price and a button that orders.
slots.checkoutFooterSameNote: The full footer, links and all
slots.checkoutPaymentsNote: Near the button, where the doubt is
slots.chromeFullNote: The full header, menu and all
slots.chromeReducedNote: No menu, no search — nothing that leads away
slots.coloursNote: One palette dresses the whole shop — pages, buttons, the header and the checkout. Save to store puts it live.
slots.cornersNote: One setting for everything the shop draws a box around — cards, buttons, inputs, pictures.
slots.designOnly: This is the new editor's design. Nothing here saves yet — the wiring comes next.
slots.partsChosen: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing chosen yet} one {# chosen} other {# chosen}}
slots.partsFull: Five pictures is the most this place holds. Remove one to add another.
slots.wiredHint: What you write here is saved and goes on your store.
slots.faceArchivo: Grotesque, a little tighter. Good on small print.
slots.faceCinzel: Capitals only. For a shop name, not for paragraphs.
slots.faceNotoBengali: The widest Bengali face, and the steadiest at small sizes.
slots.facePlayfair: A display serif with strong contrast. Reads dressed-up.
slots.facePoppins: Plain and even. The shop’s face today.
slots.faqOnNote: Opens when a shopper taps one
slots.footerColumnsNote: Every group in its own column
slots.footerMinimalNote: The name, a line of links, the year
slots.footerSplitNote: Shop one side, pages the other
slots.galleryColumnNote: Full size, one under the next
slots.galleryFrameNote: Small pictures under a big one
slots.heroVideoNote: Plays when a shopper taps it
slots.lockedWhy: This one is set by Paperbase and is not editable.
slots.marksBothNote: Account, and wishlist where it is on, beside the cart
slots.noticeMessageNote: One line across the very top
slots.pairedWith: Whichever you pick, we set the other script in {face} — an English shop still has Bengali product names, and a Bengali shop still has Latin brands and sizes.
slots.paymentsOnNote: Cash on delivery, and bKash and Nagad if any product is paid for up front.
slots.postsThreeNote: Your newest writing, kept up to date
slots.productFaqOnNote: Ones you answer for this product
slots.productReviewsCardsNote: Tall cards, customers' photos first — each opens large with its words
slots.recentOnNote: What this shopper looked at before
slots.reviewsCardsNote: Your ten newest four- and five-star reviews as tall cards, customers' photos first, moving on by themselves
slots.reviewsQuoteNote: Your ten newest good reviews, large, one at a time
slots.signupWhatsappNote: A button that opens a chat with your WhatsApp number
slots.stickyBuyNote: Follows the shopper down the page
slots.stickyBuyOffNote: Only the button in its own place
slots.trustLinePlainNote: The same words, across the page
slots.typeNote: Your shop’s language follows the face you pick. A Bengali face makes a Bengali shop.
slots.checkoutStepsNoneNote: One page, nothing to count through
slots.checkoutStepsBarNote: Shows a shopper how far along they are
slots.checkoutOrderHint: The left column. Items, delivery charge and total are worked out by the shop — what you choose here is whether a shopper may still change the order on this page.
slots.orderQuantityNote: Plus, minus and remove on every line. What your shop does today.
slots.orderFixedNote: Quantities are shown only. To change anything they go back to the cart.
slots.checkoutFormHint: The right column. Which form your checkout asks for is a shop setting rather than part of the theme, but it is saved the same way as everything else here: when you press Save to store.
slots.formExtendedNote: Name, email, phone, district, area and street address. The courier has everything it needs.
slots.formMinimalNote: Four fields. Faster to finish, but somebody has to ring back for the street address.
slots.checkoutDistrictHint: How shoppers give their district. Like the form, this is a shop setting, saved when you press Save to store.
slots.districtTextNote: A box the shopper types their district into. Their own words reach the order.
slots.districtListNote: Bangladesh's 64 districts with a search box, in your shop's language. Couriers always get a correct name.
slots.checkoutBeforePayHint: Your own words, read in the second before a shopper pays. Delivery times, what cannot be returned — anything you would otherwise have to explain after the order.
slots.beforePayNoteNote: Quiet grey text, no box. For something helpful.
slots.beforePayWarningNote: Boxed and coloured. For something they must not miss.
slots.checkoutCouponHint: Your shop has discount codes — make them under Discounts. This is only how the box looks on the page: always open, tucked behind a link, or not shown at all.
slots.couponOffNote: Nothing to type a code into. Right for a shop that runs no codes.
slots.couponLinkNote: "Have a coupon?" — opens the field only for people who have one.
slots.couponOpenNote: Always open. An empty box sends shoppers off to hunt for a code, and not all of them come back.
slots.cartHeadingWithLinkNote: "Continue shopping" beside the title. What your shop does today.
slots.cartHeadingPlainNote: Nothing beside it. The header is still a way back.
slots.cartStepsBarNote: Shows this is the first of three steps
slots.cartLinesHint: This column is the last look a shopper gets at the thing itself. The picture, the size and the colour are what stop somebody ordering the wrong one.
slots.cartTableNote: Product, quantity and total in columns. Reads faster once a cart is long.
slots.cartTrustNote: Your promises from the home page, or a line you write here
slots.cartTotalHint: The one thing a shopper opens this page to see. Beside the items it is on screen from the moment the page loads, whatever the length of the cart.
slots.cartSticky: Bar that follows on a phone
slots.cartStickyNote: Total and Check out stay at the bottom of the screen while they scroll.
slots.cartStickyOffNote: They scroll to the bottom to find the button
slots.cartUpsellHint: A shopper with a full cart has already decided to buy from you. This is the cheapest row in the shop to sell from — and the easiest to overdo, so it starts as four best sellers rather than anything clever.
slots.cartUpsellRowNote: The same four for everyone. Simple, and it never gets it wrong.
slots.cartUpsellPicksNote: Chosen against what is already in the cart.
slots.cartRecentNote: What they looked at and did not take
slots.cartPaymentsNote: Cash on delivery, and the mobile ones where the cart needs paying up front
slots.cartEmptyHint: Not a place on the page but a state of it, and the one most shops leave as a sentence. Whoever sees it arrived wanting to buy and found nothing — the cheapest sale in the shop to rescue.
slots.cartEmptyTextNote: "Your cart is empty." What your shop says today.
slots.cartEmptyInvite: A line and a way on
slots.cartEmptyInviteNote: Says it is empty, then sends them somewhere rather than leaving them there.
slots.catBreadcrumbNote: Home · the department · this category. Most people land here from a search, not from your home page.
slots.catHeadingPlainNote: The category name, then whatever you wrote about it. What your shop does today.
slots.catHeadingEyebrowNote: A word in small capitals above the name.
slots.catHeadingBannerNote: The name across the category's own image. Needs one uploaded, or it falls back to the plain name.
slots.catCountNote: "24 products" under the name. Useful on a big category, pitiful on a thin one.
slots.catSortHint: Your shop can sort by newest, price up, price down and most popular. Switching it on puts the control on the page; leave it off and the page stays in your own order.
slots.catSortOffNote: Your own order, and no way to change it. What happens today.
slots.catSortMenuNote: One dropdown, over on the right. Takes almost no room.
slots.catSortTabsNote: All five visible at once. Costs a row, but shoppers actually use it.
slots.catFiltersHint: Price, brand and whatever your products vary by — size, colour. Only the values a category actually has are offered, so a filter never leads to an empty page.
slots.catFiltersChipsNote: Opens over the page from the left. Costs the grid nothing until it is asked for.
slots.catFiltersRailNote: Everything open at once, a drawer on a phone. Costs the grid a quarter of its width.
slots.catGridHint: On a phone this is always two. What you are choosing is the computer, where a wider grid shows more at once and a narrower one shows each picture bigger.
slots.catGridFourNote: Most at once. What your shop does today.
slots.catGridTwoNote: Large pictures. For a short category where each one has to sell itself.
slots.catMoreHint: A category shows 48 products at a time. This is how a shopper reaches the rest of a big one.
slots.catMoreNoneNote: The first lot, and that is all anyone can see. Fine on a small category, a trap on a big one.
slots.catMoreButtonNote: Adds the next lot under the grid without leaving the page.
slots.catMorePagesNote: 1 2 3. Easier to send someone a link to page two, and easier to find in search.
slots.catTextBlockNote: A heading and a paragraph. What the category is, in your words, for people and for search engines.
slots.catEmptyLabel: When there is nothing in it
slots.catEmptyInvite: A line and a way on
slots.catEmptyHint: A category with no products is usually one that sold out or has not been filled yet. Either way somebody followed a link and found a blank page.
slots.catEmptyTextNote: "No products in this category yet." What your shop says today.
slots.catEmptyInviteNote: Says it, then sends them to something you do have.
slots.searchHeadingCountNote: Results for what they typed, and how many. Tells them at once whether it is worth reading.
slots.searchHeadingPlainNote: No number. Kinder when the answer is one.
slots.searchCategoriesNote: Above the products. Someone searching a department’s name usually wants that whole department, not one product.
slots.searchMoreHint: Search shows 48 products at a time. This is how a shopper reaches the rest of a long answer.
slots.searchMoreNoneNote: The first 48 and no way to the rest. What your shop does today.
slots.searchEmptyHint: Someone who searched and found nothing told you exactly what they wanted and you did not have it. The least you can do is not leave them on a blank page. A misspelled word is caught first: when a search finds nothing, a word one or two letters away from your own product names is searched for instead, and the shopper is told.
slots.searchEmptyTextNote: “Nothing found for that.” What your shop says today.
slots.searchEmptyInviteNote: Says it, then offers the categories you do have.
slots.searchPromptHint: What a shopper sees the moment search opens, and after one letter — it takes two to search.
slots.searchPromptHintNote: “Type at least two letters to search.” Short, and it says why nothing has happened yet.
slots.searchPromptTrendingNote: Your best sellers instead of an empty page.
slots.blogHeadingNote: A name and a line saying what the blog is for, in your words.
slots.blogSearchNote: Filters the posts already on the page as they type. Worth it past a dozen posts.
slots.blogTagsHint: Your posts already carry tags and the shop can already filter by one — the public blog list takes a tag parameter and honours it. Nothing on the page offers them.
slots.blogTagsRowNote: One tap narrows the list. Only worth it once posts fall into real groups.
slots.blogFeaturedHint: You already mark posts as featured. This is only about how much room the marked ones get.
slots.blogFeaturedShelfNote: The marked posts as a row, four across.
slots.blogFeaturedHeroNote: The first marked post gets a picture and the full width. What your shop does today.
slots.blogLatestGridNote: Cards, four across. Pictures do the work.
slots.blogLatestRowsNote: One post a row with a small picture. More titles visible at once.
slots.blogCardsPictureNote: No summary. Tidier, and the title has to work harder.
slots.blogCardsWordsNote: No pictures at all. Fast, and honest when posts have no good image.
slots.blogMetaHint: A card knows the date and the read count — both ship with every post. It does not know the author: that is only on the post itself, which is why the byline is a choice over there and not here.
slots.blogMetaDateNote: When it went up. Fine until a post is two years old.
slots.blogMetaReadsNote: Already counted on every post. Convincing on a popular one, quiet on a new one.
slots.blogTextBlockNote: A heading and a paragraph under the posts, in your words.
slots.articleBackNote: A link to the blog above the title.
slots.articleBackOffNote: The header is the only way out
slots.articleBylineHint: The name is the first and last name of the account that wrote the post — never its email. A name makes advice read as somebody's rather than as the shop's.
slots.articleBylineDateNote: When it went up, and nothing else.
slots.articleBylineAuthorNote: Somebody wrote this, and saying who makes it worth more.
slots.articleBodyHint: How wide a line of text runs. Long lines are harder to read than they look — the eye loses its place coming back to the left.
slots.articleBodyNarrowNote: Around sixty-five characters a line, which is what reads easiest.
slots.articleBodyWideNote: Uses the whole page. Better for posts that are mostly pictures.
slots.articleTagsNote: What the post is about. Each opens the blog's posts with that tag, when the blog shows its tag row.
slots.articlePrevNextNote: Somebody who finished reading is the likeliest person in the shop to read another.
slots.articleRelatedNote: Three posts at the end, the same tag first, so the page does not simply stop.
slots.wishHeadingCountNote: Wishlist (4). A number worth seeing when it has grown.
slots.wishHeadingPlainNote: Just the word, however many are saved.
slots.wishItemsGridNote: Cards with a cross in the corner. Pictures sell the reminder.
slots.wishItemsRowsNote: One a row, small and dense. More of them on a screen at once.
slots.wishActionHint: A wishlist is a list of things somebody already wanted. Whether they can buy from it without going anywhere else is the only decision on this page that changes what it is for.
slots.wishActionCartNote: Buy straight from the list, with whatever button your card style carries.
slots.wishActionLookNote: Tap through to the product page first. Fewer accidents, more steps.
slots.wishEmptyHint: Almost everyone who opens a wishlist for the first time sees this, so it is the version of the page most people meet.
slots.wishEmptyTextNote: “Nothing saved yet.” One line, and they leave.
slots.wishEmptyInviteNote: Says what the heart does, then sends them to find something.
slots.accountGreetingNameNote: “Hello, Nasrin”. Warmer, and it confirms they are in the right place.
slots.accountGreetingPlainNote: “Your account”. Plainer, and it never gets the name wrong.
slots.accountGreetingHint: Their picture, their email and phone, how long they have been a member, what they have here, and their newest order. Choose how it greets them.
slots.accountOrdersRowsNote: Number, date, where it is, total. Scans like a statement.
slots.accountOrdersCardsNote: With the pictures of what was in it, so an old order is recognisable at a glance.
slots.accountEmptyInviteNote: Says it, then sends them to the shop rather than to nothing.
slots.cartLinesCardsNote: Picture, size, colour, price and a stepper on each. What your reference shows.
slots.cartTotalFullNote: Subtotal, delivery and total, worked out line by line.
slots.cartTotalSimpleNote: One number. Fewer questions before checkout, and fewer answers.
slots.promoCardBodyExample: Everything in outerwear, twenty percent off until Friday.
slots.bandsHint: Three of your categories. Each row shows that category and everything in it.
slots.promoStripNote: A headline, a message and a button
slots.promoBehindNote: Full width, words over the photo
slots.placeIsPaid: This section is part of Premium.
slots.accountReviewsHint: The one thing this page holds that no other page does. A shopper sees every review they wrote here — live, waiting for you, or turned down — and can change or delete their own.
slots.accountReviewsOnNote: Every one they wrote, in every state, theirs to change.
slots.accountReviewsOffNote: A review they are waiting on cannot be found, so they write it again.
slots.articleHeadUnderNote: The post's own picture below its title. What your shop does today.
slots.articleHeadTopNote: The post's picture across the whole page, over the title.
slots.articleHeadOffNote: Straight into the words. A post with no picture uploaded always looks like this.
slots.reviewsPageBars: The score and its star bars
slots.reviewsPageBarsNote: Your shop's average, and how many gave each number of stars. A shopper taps a bar to see only those.
slots.reviewsPageNothingNote: Straight to the reviews and their filters.
slots.reviewsPageLayoutHint: Every published review in your shop, newest first, each naming its product. Shoppers narrow them by stars, category and product.
slots.reviewsPageRowsNote: One after another in a reading column, the way a review is read.
slots.reviewsPageCardsNote: Three across, so more are seen at once.
slots.footerColumnsHint: Your own columns: a title and up to six links each — pages, categories, your policies or web addresses. Up to four columns.
slots.detailRowsHint: Product details, with the specifications inside, is always there. Write your shipping and exchange words below and add rows of your own, each with a heading, an icon and some text. A row with no words is not shown.
slots.palettesFailed: Your colour choices couldn't be loaded. Refresh the page to try again.
slots.headerClassicNote: The name and the menu on the left, the icons on the right
slots.headerCentredNote: Search, the name in the middle, the icons — and the menu in its own row below
slots.headerSplitNote: The name on the left, the menu in the middle of the page
slots.headerMinimalNote: The name and a small-capitals menu on the left
slots.headerCompactNote: The menu behind a button, as on a phone. The quietest.
slots.stickyScrollUpNote: Hides on the way down, comes back on the way up
slots.stickyAlwaysNote: Stays at the top the whole way down
slots.headerWordsOnNote: Search, Account and Cart written beside their icons, on a computer
slots.logoPlaceHint: Your logo in place of your shop's name — SVG is sharpest, or a PNG with a see-through background. Leave the picture empty to show your name.
slots.logoSmallNote: A quiet mark beside the menu.
slots.logoLargeNote: A logo that leads the page.
slots.headerMenuHint: Your own links across the header: pages of your shop, your categories or any web address, in your order, one of them in your brand colour if you like. Leave it empty to show your categories.
slots.headerButtonHint: A button of your own at the right of the header, like “Order on WhatsApp”: your words and where it goes. On a phone it sits at the top of the menu. Leave the words empty for no button.
slots.signupMessengerNote: A button that opens a chat with your Facebook page
slots.signupFacebookNote: A button that opens your Facebook page
slots.signupInstagramNote: A button that opens your Instagram
slots.signupTiktokNote: A button that opens your TikTok
slots.signupNoFacebook: Messenger chats go to your Facebook page, and your shop has no Facebook account yet, so the band is hidden.
slots.socialFromIdentity: Your accounts, and their order, come from Identity in Settings > Store Info.
slots.socialNoneYet: Your shop has no social accounts yet. Add them under Identity in Settings > Store Info.
slots.signupNoAccounts: The button opens one of your accounts, and your shop has none yet, so the band is hidden.
slots.signupNoAccount: Your shop has no {platform} account yet, so the band is hidden.
slots.signupYoutubeNote: A button that opens your YouTube channel
slots.signupTelegramNote: A button that opens your Telegram
slots.signupXNote: A button that opens your X profile
slots.signupLinkedinNote: A button that opens your LinkedIn page
slots.signupPinterestNote: A button that opens your Pinterest
slots.signupThreadsNote: A button that opens your Threads
slots.signupSnapchatNote: A button that opens your Snapchat
slots.checkoutHint: The way down to the form, on phones
slots.checkoutHintHint: On a phone the order comes first and the form under it. A shopper still on their order after the seconds below sees a small arrow at the bottom, and a tap on it takes them to the form. Nothing moves on its own.
slots.checkoutHintOnNote: A small arrow at the bottom
slots.successTop: The top, for cash on delivery
slots.successTopHint: What a shopper sees above the heading after a cash-on-delivery order. The heading and the order stay as they are, and an order paid in advance keeps its own words.
slots.successWordsNote: A thank-you, or when you will call
slots.cardAlignNote: Where the name and price sit on every card in your shop.

themeEditor.shopSettingFailed: Your checkout form could not be saved. Everything else was.
themeEditor.previewClickDoes: What a click in your shop does
themeEditor.previewSample: Filled with a sample of your own products so you can see it full. Nothing here is saved.
